student_learning_goal: I can make 50¢ in 3 different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make 50¢ in 3 different ways.
header.character_watermark: Tappy the Toonie Frog in the top-right with a tap-to-pay card. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw 3 different ways to make 50¢ using coins.
parts.visual_layout: Three blank combo workspaces with 50 cents target labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 three-way combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 blank workspaces, each labelled '50¢ =' for drawing coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_THREE at Part 1: keywords name the combo blank workspaces.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 combos, mark TRUE if total = 50¢, FALSE if not.
parts.visual_layout: Three combo pictures with TRUE/FALSE circles each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 true-or-false combo layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 combos: 1) 2 quarters (T), 2) 5 dimes (T), 3) 4 quarters (F=$1). Each with TRUE/FALSE circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_TF at Part 2: keywords name the combos true-false check.

parts.student_instructions: Make 50¢ using ONLY DIMES. How many?
parts.visual_layout: An empty workspace with 50 cents label and dime drawing space.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 2 dimes-only workspace for money worksheet, B&W line art. Blank workspace with '50¢ =' label. Below: '___ dimes' answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_DIMES at Part 3: keywords name the dimes answer space.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a 4th way for 50¢ using nickels.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check combo creation.
